_comment: Photo headers. Source photos live in design/heroes/<name>.jpg. Crops are [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels: 'wide' (~5:2) is used from 640px wide, 'tall' (~3:4) on phones. Run `python3 scripts/hero-images.py` after editing. Optional 'position' sets the focal point (CSS object-position) when a photo is cropped further on small screens.
